import json, subprocess, sys

def run(doc):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '/app/submission/main.py'],
                       input=json.dumps(doc).encode(), capture_output=True)
    return json.loads(p.stdout)

def base(cfg_over=None, pkts=None):
    cfg = {"slots": 1, "window": 1, "idle_timeout": 10**12, "len_quantum": 1,
           "gap_quantum": 1, "rate_num": 1000000, "rate_den": 1,
           "bucket_capacity": 512, "initial_tokens": 512, "pending_capacity": 512,
           "lanes": 1, "service": [10, 10], "fallback": 0, "time_edges": [0],
           "count_edges": [0], "probability": [[65536]]}
    if cfg_over: cfg.update(cfg_over)
    model = {"classes": 2, "embedding_dim": 1,
             "length_embedding": [[i] for i in range(16)],
             "gap_embedding": [[0] for _ in range(16)],
             "kernel": 1, "conv_weights": [[[1, 0]]], "conv_bias": [0],
             "conv_shift": [0], "dense_weights": [[0], [1]], "dense_bias": [0, 0]}
    return {"version": 1, "config": cfg, "model": model,
            "connections": [{"id": "x", "slot": 0, "label": 0, "split": "dev"}],
            "packets": pkts}

# queue decisions must not consume credit
o = run(base({"pending_capacity": 2, "lanes": 1, "service": [10, 10]},
             [{"time": t, "connection": "x", "length": 0, "draw": 0} for t in range(4)]))
print("D credits:", [p["credit"] for p in o["packets"]],
      [p["decision"] for p in o["packets"]])
assert [p["credit"] for p in o["packets"]] == [511, 511, 512, 512]

# job finishing exactly at t frees capacity before the queue check
o = run(base({"pending_capacity": 1, "lanes": 1, "service": [1, 1]},
             [{"time": t, "connection": "x", "length": 0, "draw": 0} for t in range(5)]))
print("E:", [(p["decision"], p["credit"], p["job"]) for p in o["packets"]])
assert [p["decision"] for p in o["packets"]] == ["sent"] * 5
assert [j["status"] for j in o["jobs"]] == ["applied"] * 5

# probability failure must not consume credit nor reset anchor/backlog
o = run(base({"probability": [[0]]},
             [{"time": t, "connection": "x", "length": 0, "draw": 0} for t in range(4)]))
print("F:", [(p["decision"], p["credit"]) for p in o["packets"]])
assert all(p["decision"] == "probability" and p["credit"] == 512 for p in o["packets"])
assert o["jobs"] == []
print("OK")
PYEOF
